data:
Damn I never expected to give a good review to this game... but dont blame me.

I got the game, yeah? I got overwhelmed for the first week and it was a love and hate relationship between me and how much this game reminded me of my job.

Well i stopped for a few weeks and then I came back and then 120 hours or so later I love it. 
5 3 2
5 4 1 
my favourite formations

reddit community had been the best and helped a lot. 

also so addicting after you get how it works...
Its got football, its got managing, its 24, what more does a man or women or dog or cat or chicken or fish or mermaid or any living mammal need?

I just spent 300 euros just to get this game, after it was taken off all of the stores. Although I am sad that I spent that much money, I don't feel guilty about it. This might be a way to cope with the pain, idk.

Can't wait to manage the 4th tier in Latvia.
by far the most high effort and high quality sports game out there on any platform.

124 hours into this game and i still cant make a winning tactic to save my life. but every now and then i go back to it and log another 10 over the span of a few days. few games get me into the story of my players and club quite like it. every time i score a goal in a tight game or hold onto a close lead I'm on the edge of my seat, love it.
I have very good internet just sometimes when you load it up it takes forever to load

A game you can really sink so many hours in too.

Taking my sh*t Manchester United team and winning everything there is to win is a great experience.

Debt. Takeovers. Almost relegation. Managing finances. It’s all here.

The journey is long. But rewarding.

Despite the fumble with FM25, SI has delivered an amazing experience on FM24 that doesn't necessarily need modernization. While the base game itself is good, custom databases and game engine tweaks are where the gold is. Creating storylines, developing young talent, managing your favorite teams, FM24 brings to life the drama and passion all us Football fans have.
Great game signed players , yelled at said players as they forgot what sport they were playing , rinse and repeat .

Dont download this game I thought this game was something good and now steam will not refund because I accidentally let my game on for over 2 hrs. Becareful I will see if there is platform buy game and you guys should do the same. Peace
Love this game, first time playing FM, takes a little to understand but once you do, you are hooked.

Nice new features.
Few teething issues which are usual
good fm experience

match engine feels a lot more realistic this time
best FM yet, match engine has improved dramatically, cant wait to see what it looks like in FM 25
This game is the best game in the world, i have been playing Fifa since P.E.S, and when i started playing FM 24, I fell in love with it and this is the best game in the world
Great FM with easy interface and fun to play. I have been playing for many years now and enjoy this version better than FM "^
The last great FM. I highly recommend trying to get hold of a CD Key, if possible.
More of the same great game. I pick up a copy every 3-4 years and this is the best I can remember even if the experience is roughly the same as 2020.
Football Manager is a very cool game.Especially for tactial foxes.Only the graphic is not so good but overall it is a very good game

Playing it since 1996 when it was Championship Manager and Blackburn Rovers were champions. When they split and became Football Manager it was even better with 3D players. FM2013 was first I bought via Steam. Addictive 99,95 % !
Got sacked after half a season at HSV. Now i'm managing Fleetwood in Sky Bet League One. Never heard of them before, now i love them. Sums up the game pretty good.

DEFINITLY DONT BUY ! After 1 year of existing they deleting content from the game to sell it longer, Even if it will be the smallest thing dont let them do it to YOU, NEVER! I'm deleting couse it is a right thing to do right now. It is sad but it's true.
after playing fm27 and fm26 I can comfortably say that this is the last good fm game
i guest people already know, what FM and why we still come even with only minor update for each series

Gud game. runs smooth. has real leages, clubs and players. but man is it complicated. a little bit too much micro managment for my taste. had to klick around for 1 hour before i could play my first match. and of course in the first test match my favorite player gets injured and cant play for 3 weeks :/
The game keeps crashing at the team selection screen after 40h of play. I can no longer pick my squad, the only way to launch a game is to leave the squad unchanged.

Resolved alot of the previous gripes. Set piece overhaul is the main change for me this year. Much better to manage.

New positions have also made some nice new changes to tactics and the meta.

FM24 without doubt is the most complete FM going into a new era next season with the unity engine.

The game is the most complete version of Football Manager. From the recent changes, I like the new ball physics and transfer offloading options through intermediaries and agents. The set pieces system seems nice but potentially may be abused with certain setups, so I need more tinkering with it. Saudi clubs are feeding clubs with money, but feel like reality. This is the most stable game I highly recommend, as the Unity game engine in FM25 bears a significant risk.

I hope the game developers will include more match statistics, so I can do even more cool analytics stuff with the MoneyballFM website (moneyballfm.com).

437 hours of shite. addicted to this because of other iterations of this game. this version has been the least satisfying of any version ive ever played all the way back to the begining when the collyer boys built it
If you want to have a life don't play this game. It's cool though 👍

The best football game in the world, simple as that, Currently on year 2040 in my save and no signs of stopping. I've been playing since FM20 and it just gets better and better every year and ive put in more and more hours every year

You wont regret buying it (Just make sure you get face+log packs)

Best football game I have ever played, used to be a fifa career mode player but this is 10x better. With all of the in depth stats on players and variety of different tactics its got everything. Even better when you play with friends.

Same game new year? Well not quite, that feel the game looks like last year, but with some tweeks and improvs that take the experience to the next level, and one of the good things is that you can port the save you have from FM23 to this game and continue the save you have.
Its good Fm sense we don't have FM 25 not sure is gone be good will see . this game is fun i been playing when want relax

POTENTIAL BUYER ALERT: Because SI could not make and publish FM25 on time, FM24's 4th of December patch REMOVES contents from the game so that they can put this for sale until who-knows-when they release FM25. If you want a full game, DO NOT BUY.

I have an old Alienware computer which was really good 10 years ago. Now it doesn't recognise the Nvidia card so is just playing on the integrated video card. For this reason I was concerned at getting FM24. But considering the computers limitations (the game gives it 1 star) the matches are really enjoyable and play much better than in previous versions. Well done to the devs who haven't left those with old computers like me behind.
The match engine of FM24 is more satisfying compared to FM21, whence I transitioned. I also enjoy the more nuanced transfer mechanics.

Wait for FM25 as it will be drastically different from this.

If you dont care, buy this and you will not regret it.
Been playing the series for the last decade and I have really enjoyed myself with this game so far.
I couldn't ask more: football + simulation (in a in-depth way), played career mode for years until found out this game.
I have always loved sport management games, this franchise/game has set the bar for what I should expect

The match engine is much more fun overall than the previous editions I had played (17, 20, and 22). However, the AI still has a hard time managing the fitness of players, and they will neglect developing their good young players if they have a good squad.

Incredible game!

The game play as a football manager is amazing. You can feel the real pressure to perform and deliver, naturally intertwined with the glory of hard-fought wins. You can make the game your own, you can play as top-down manager, manager-analyst, manager-coach or anyone in between. You can watch full matches and make necessary corrections or delegate the game to analyse later. You can manage a top-tier club to a Champions League title, save a low-tier division side from oblivion, or start as looking for job.

My son loves it, I love it, and we have had a great time playing together, that is why we clocked hundreds of hours (the game pushed aside all other games from the library). It allowed us to be better outfield, at the actual football pitch, where we use the training ideas, roles, duties, and other analytics that feature in the game. It does not feel like it s a game any more, but something bigger.
Great game with lots of depth. Learn the system and it can be super fulfilling. Resist the temptation to just download game breakers. :-)
Similar to other FM games. Great level of details and can't wait to see improved shouts and tactics in FM26

The best version of Football Manager there has ever been. It's entertaining even 1000 hours into the game, and I still see goals and pieces of play that I have not seen before. The game does boast a look of something from 2007, but that is part of the charm. The game is not about that, it's about the grind to take your team to the top. The transfers, the scouting, the tactics, the training - it's all very good and you can go as in depth as you like, or just let your assistant manager do it all. Wonderful. FM24 will not be beaten by a Football Sim game anytime soon.

As a football fan and virtual manager, FM24 delivers another addictive and realistic experience. The match engine feels smoother, tactical depth is greater than ever, and squad dynamics are more immersive.

👍 Pros:

Deeper tactical customization

More human-like player interactions

Flexible data editor

Cleaner and more user-friendly UI


👎 Cons:

Minor bugs in media interactions

Some unrealistic AI transfer decisions


🎯 Perfect for those who love strategy, long-term planning, and turning underdogs into European giants.
📌 Pro tip: Be patient during your first few seasons—especially with mid-table clubs. Your vision will pay off after a couple of transfer windows.

💬 Verdict: 9/10 – A must-play for true football lovers!
dont play this game you'll get addicted but you should play it because its the best football game on the market

I really liked this football manager, the game can be suffering but it does not feel like unfair suffering. I recommend this more as a single player game than playing it with friends or Multiplayer In general. The scouting has gotten better than the last games. The graphics are still the same for a long time but that’s not the point of this game, the realism in the game can suck or be annoying but its fair and makes every save challenging. I recommend this Football Manager. it’s sad that FM 2025 is cancelled but FM 2024 is filling the void as much as possible but that wont last for ever and 1 more thing MAKE THE INGAME EDITOR FREE!
The best this series will be for a while, keep going back to it as it's got everything going for it, even with the little bugs.
It's an addictive in depth sports simulator that allows you to take control of your favorite team and make key decisions ranging from player sales, buys, to management, even down to training regimes!

tldr.text: Very Positive (93%): players praise many different parts of the game, with no single thing standing out.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, with no single problem standing out.

details.text: Recent reviews are even warmer, at 96% positive over the last month, which is above the game's all-time score.
Players in their first hours are much less positive at 58%, while long-time players stay near 93%.
